title: A novel synthesis of ditrimethylolpropane biphosphoramide diethyleneamine as flame retardant and antistatic textiles
washing_state: Untreated scoured source fabric; no experimental durability wash assigned
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Untreated woven scoured wool fabric; Table 4 and Figure 9
source_material_form_LOI_raw: Untreated wool fabric; measured mean LOI in section 7
treatment_method: Woven scoured wool fabric, 220 g/m², with fiber diameter 38 µm. No experimental DBD treatment, curing or durability wash is assigned. Drying in the weight-gain method and the treated-fabric recipe are not transferred to the untreated TG/LOI control.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Original woven scoured wool fabric aliquot; specimen mass, crucible material and cutting/grinding are not reported.
LOI_instrument: ZR-01, Qingdao Shanfang Instrument Co. Ltd.
LOI_locator: Printed p.881, PDF p.10, section 7 explicitly reports untreated LOI 25.7%; p.875 section 4-10 states the own oxygen-index instrument, standard and three-repeat mean.
TG_locator: Printed p.879, PDF p.8, Table 4; p.878 section 5 defines T5% and Tmax as the temperature at maximum weight-loss rate; Figure 9 confirms untreated/treated fabric traces under nitrogen and air.
conditions_locator: Printed p.874: source fabric; p.875 sections 4-7 and 4-10: own TG and LOI methods.
pairing_evidence: Untreated woven scoured wool fabric is named consistently in own TG Table 4/Figure 9 and own LOI results section 7. Its source fabric is 220 g/m² with LOI 25.7 and a TG tuple distinct from ANPP wool at 130 g/m² and LOI 24.0. No values are borrowed between these sources.
source_access_method: Official thirteen-page KIChE PDF downloaded. Original methods, results, tables, conclusion and references reviewed; TG Table 4, Figure 9 and own assay evidence pixels checked.
limitations: Only untreated wool is proposed. Preparation uses DBD 200 g in 800 mL water with 160 °C curing for 3 min, whereas optimization and the conclusion specify 300 g/L and 90 s. Generic treated TG/LOI labels do not explicitly resolve the selected loading and cure; treated candidates remain held. Treated nitrogen Tmax1 conflicts between Table 4 (305 °C) and prose (313 °C). Untreated values agree across Table 4 and prose, and Figure 9 shows no obvious endpoint contradiction; air residue 33.0% is preserved exactly. Air Table 4 has three distinct maximum-rate peaks, 79/286/513 °C. The third is retained separately in source-native form because this draft has two canonical peak fields. Two TG repetitions and three LOI repetitions are explicit; no SD is invented. The prose calls the derivative analysis DTA while the figure caption names DTG, but the source explicitly defines Tmax as temperature at maximum weight-loss rate. The extracted INVITED REVIEW PAPER string is not relied upon as publication classification. The body presents its own original experiment and measured tables.

TGA_statistic: Mean of two repeated experiments, source section 4-7
source_metric_holds: All DBD-treated states: exact treatment/cure and wash assignment unresolved. Treated nitrogen Tmax1 conflicts between 305 and 313 °C. Air control third peak 513 °C is retained raw; it is not discarded or merged with another peak.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Own measured LOI 25.7 in prose and tabulated untreated fabric TG in Table 4.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Tested at room temperature; LOI specimen dimensions and conditioning are not reported.
source_title: A novel synthesis of ditrimethylolpropane biphosphoramide diethyleneamine as flame retardant and antistatic textiles
